name: Amp (Sourcegraph)
disclaimer: Written from documented interface, not verified against an install.

stdin.note: Verified from the execute mode documentation (ampcode.com/docs/cli/execute-mode), read 2026-09-17: its example pipes the whole prompt to `amp -x` with no message. Continuing a thread with piped input is not documented, so resume declares none.

options.model_note: Amp selects models internally; no user-facing model flag.

--dangerously-allow-all.why: Kept, and leaving it out narrows nothing: since May 2026 Amp asks no permission before a tool runs unless permissions are configured, and narrowing it takes a tool.call plugin or permission settings, neither of which ao writes. Read on 2026-09-17 from ampcode.com/news/neo, ampcode.com/docs/tools and ampcode.com/docs/cli/execute-mode.
